parameters.name: AcceleratorId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the **RequestId** of the API request as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** may be different for each API request.

parameters.name: EndpointGroupIds
parameters.description: The list of endpoint group IDs.

parameters.name: ListenerId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the listener.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Set the value to **cn-hangzhou**.

parameters.name: SlsLogStoreName
parameters.description: The name of the SLS Logstore.

parameters.name: SlsProjectName
parameters.description: The name of the SLS project.

parameters.name: SlsRegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the SLS service.
